tools.name: promote_member_to_channel_admin
tools.description: Grants a workspace member the admin role in a channel, giving them permission to manage that channel's settings and members.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the member to promote

tools.code:
import os
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("team-chat")

API = os.environ.get("CHAT_API_URL", "https://chat.internal.example.com/api/v1")
TOKEN = os.environ["CHAT_API_TOKEN"]


@mcp.tool()
def promote_member_to_channel_admin(channel_id: str, user_id: str) -> dict:
    url = f"{API}/channels/{channel_id}/members/{user_id}/role"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {TOKEN}"}
    resp = requests.put(url, json={"role": "admin"}, headers=headers, timeout=15)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()
    return {
        "channel_id": channel_id,
        "user_id": user_id,
        "role": data.get("role", "admin"),
    }

tools.name: get_channel_activity_summary
tools.description: Looks up message counts and the most active posters for a channel over the last N days. Only reads data.

params.name: days
params.description: Number of days to look back

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import time
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB = "workspace.db"


@tool
def get_channel_activity_summary(channel: str, days: int) -> dict:
    cut = time.time() - days * 86400
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    cur = con.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m JOIN channels c ON c.id = m.channel_id "
        "WHERE c.name = ? AND m.ts >= ?",
        (channel, cut),
    )
    n = cur.fetchone()[0]
    cur.execute(
        "SELECT u.display_name, COUNT(*) AS k FROM messages m "
        "JOIN channels c ON c.id = m.channel_id JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id "
        "WHERE c.name = ? AND m.ts >= ? GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY k DESC LIMIT 5",
        (channel, cut),
    )
    top = [{"user": r[0], "messages": r[1]} for r in cur.fetchall()]
    con.close()
    return {"channel": channel, "days": days, "total": n, "top_posters": top}

tools.name: refund_workspace_seat_charge
tools.description: Looks up a paid seat charge for a workspace member and issues a refund for it to the customer's card. Returns the refund details along with the original charge.

params.name: charge_id
params.description: Stripe charge ID of the seat purchase

tools.code:
import os
import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]


@tool
def refund_workspace_seat_charge(workspace_id: str, charge_id: str, amount_cents: int) -> dict:
    charge = stripe.Charge.retrieve(charge_id)
    paid = charge["amount"] - charge["amount_refunded"]
    amount = min(amount_cents, paid)
    refund = stripe.Refund.create(
        charge=charge_id,
        amount=amount,
        reason="requested_by_customer",
        metadata={"workspace_id": workspace_id},
    )
    return {
        "refund_id": refund["id"],
        "status": refund["status"],
        "refunded_cents": refund["amount"],
        "original_charge_cents": charge["amount"],
        "currency": charge["currency"],
    }

tools.name: purge_old_channel_messages
tools.description: Permanently deletes messages older than a given number of days from a channel, along with their reactions and attachment records. Pinned messages are kept.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: ID of the channel to clean up

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Delete messages older than this many days

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import time
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB = "workspace.db"


def _old_ids(con, channel_id, cutoff):
    cur = con.execute(
        "SELECT id FROM messages WHERE channel_id = ? AND ts < ? AND pinned = 0",
        (channel_id, cutoff),
    )
    return [r[0] for r in cur.fetchall()]


def _delete_in_chunks(con, table, column, ids):
    total = 0
    for i in range(0, len(ids), 500):
        chunk = ids[i:i + 500]
        marks = ",".join("?" for _ in chunk)
        cur = con.execute(
            f"DELETE FROM {table} WHERE {column} IN ({marks})",
            chunk,
        )
        total += cur.rowcount
    return total


@tool
def purge_old_channel_messages(channel_id: str, older_than_days: int) -> dict:
    cutoff = time.time() - older_than_days * 86400
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    try:
        ids = _old_ids(con, channel_id, cutoff)
        reactions = _delete_in_chunks(con, "reactions", "message_id", ids)
        files = _delete_in_chunks(con, "attachments", "message_id", ids)
        msgs = _delete_in_chunks(con, "messages", "id", ids)
        con.commit()
    except Exception:
        con.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        con.close()
    return {
        "channel_id": channel_id,
        "messages_deleted": msgs,
        "reactions_deleted": reactions,
        "attachments_deleted": files,
    }
